entities.summary: Martin Georg Kocher is an Austrian economist, academic, and former politician who is serving as Governor of the Austrian National Bank since September 2025. He was minister in the governments of Sebastian Kurz, Karl Nehammer and Alexander Schallenberg. From January 2021 he was Minister for Labour and from May 2022 to March 2025, he held the position of Minister for Labour and Economic Affairs.
